790530101.text: "Welcome to the Veluriyam Mirage. I hope you can relax and enjoy some respite from your tiring journey."

790530102.text: That's how I would have greeted you if things had been different... *sigh* It's hard to believe how much has happened.

790530103.text: Since everything's fixed now, I thought... Better late than never. What do you think? Pretty professional, huh?

790530105.text: Uh... do you want me to explain the underlying theory? I don't actually know that much about it. In short, a Preprint is like an idea...

790530106.text: Think of it like how a plant should grow is imprinted in its seed, or how a bird will spread its wings is determined while it's still in its egg.

790530107.text: Things follow these instincts and rules that are programmed into them and become that which we see around us. Perhaps the blueprints of all things were created at the very beginning.

790530108.text: A Preprint is like those blueprints, and the light reflected through the bottle transforms them into the entire Veluriyam Mirage. Ah, but this kind of magic only works within the confines of the bottle.

790530110.text: Oh, are you wondering why we fled Fontaine? It feels like it happened a lifetime ago...

790530111.text: The reason for our flight... it would be the "water". The waters of Fontaine changed, and to the Oceanids, now the waters there are full of... pain and hatred...?

790530112.text: For us, if we wanted to live, fleeing was the best choice. Oh, it was then that became lost and fainted in the desert...

790530113.text: I must say, this desert is really just too vast!

790530115.text: Huh, Rhodeia? Have you met her?

790530116.text: Looks like she finally found a place for herself... Qingce Village? Is that in Liyue? You really have gone far away, Rhodeia...

790530118.text: Yeah, I will... I will work hard! And please do enjoy the humid environment here. You'll rarely come across such a place in the desert!

790531302.text: We found a pocket watch! Look! Is this the legendary Mora Pocketwatch!?

790531305.text: Hmm, let me take a look...

790531306.text: Y-You really found it!? Is this ordained by destiny?

790531307.text: The ultimate prize left by the mysterious adventurer was found by the legendary Traveler...

790531308.text: I sense some sort of... spiritual legacy!

790531309.text: Paimon is really happy to be praised like that, but Paimon is more curious about what happens next...

790531401.text: Oh, it's you two. What is it? You look like you have questions.

790531402.text: If it's answers about Veluriyam Mirage that you seek, then you've come to the right person. I know Veluriyam Mirage like the ripples on my palm.

790531404.text: It's just a metaphor! I'd never have any wrinkles, never!

790531407.text: Anyway, let Paimon bring you up to speed! We found this letter in the park!

790531408.text: Idyia, you must know where this came from, right?

790531409.text: Of course, it's obviously from... Huh? It's my first time seeing such a letter...

790531410.text: The ripples on your palm aren't looking too clear now...

790531411.text: S-Someone must have buried it while I wasn't paying attention. It's not surprising that I'm seeing it for the first time now.

790531412.text: And based on its contents, it's closer to a will and a chronicle than a letter. But who? The tone of the writing feels quite familiar...

790531413.text: It seems related to the Shinrou Casket?

790531414.text: Ah! Now that you mentioned it, you're right, it is from the old man who brought the Shinrou Casket. It's... it's something that happened not too long after I arrived in the bottle.

790531415.text: The old man was from Inazuma. His first question upon arriving here was whether this Domain fulfills wishes, and he wanted to be sent to a battlefield of the past...

790531416.text: I tried to explain it to him, but... His physical condition was terrible when he arrived, and even his mind was clearly at its limit from his arduous journey...

790531417.text: He kept repeating things like "I beg you, send me back to that day" or "send me back to that war..."

790531418.text: So, I used the bottle's mirage to recreate the battlefield from his mind.

790531419.text: Oh! So when he mentioned "finally returning" in the letter...

790531420.text: It's probably because when he woke up in a daze, the mirage surrounding him was already the image of the battlefield in his memories. It was quite a scary battlefield, but he had such a big smile on his face.

790531421.text: Why would someone wish to see something so terrifying in their last moments?

790531406.text: I-It's just a metaphor. It's no different from your palm print. Nothing special, really.
